name: Greenbone OPENVAS SCAN
summary: OPENVAS SCAN is Greenbone's appliance for scanning desktops, servers and network gear. Its Enterprise Feed adds EPSS-based prioritization, and its ticket system assigns and verifies fixes. A free Community Edition exists, while appliance prices are quoted on request.

facts.text: Greenbone says OPENVAS SCAN offers more than 200,000 vulnerability tests and covers desktops, servers, routers and VoIP devices.

The Enterprise Feed includes every Community Feed test and adds EPSS-based prioritization, CIS Benchmark compliance checks and coverage of products such as Cisco, Microsoft Exchange and Palo Alto Networks.
Greenbone's manual describes remediation tickets that can be assigned to users, with the statuses Open, Fixed, Fixed verified and Closed. A repeat scan sets Fixed verified automatically.
OPENVAS BASIC is available for a free 14-day trial, and the products page lists no prices.
The Community Feed is free and included in OPENVAS FREE.

plans.name: OPENVAS FREE (Community Feed)
plans.notes: Free feed without EPSS prioritization, CIS compliance checks or Enterprise Support

plans.name: OPENVAS BASIC
plans.notes: For small companies and individual users. 14-day free trial. No price listed
